services.name: 16mm Film Workshop
services.desc: Workshops are $50 each and include all materialsFor more information, or to register, please contact Cat: cat@fluxmediagallery.org Experimental filmmaker Dave Johnson, a member of the RAW STOCK film collective, will teach how to use a 16 mm Bolex camera, and do light meter readings for exposing B&W film. Then participants will shoot and hand process 16 mm negative film, and project the final films! RAW STOCK Film Collective was formed in late 2023 by a group of 4 media artists from Victoria BC: Anthony Carr, Dave Johnson, Trace Nelson and Peter Sandmark.
